_doc: Room-unique relics for the five rooms added in data/hall/building_v4.json: the Lounge Bar, the Beer Cellar, the Car Park, the Manager's Flat and the Boiler Room. Each is hidden in one room spot ('unique') and nowhere else.

relics.name: The Pint That Won't Stop
relics.desc: Poured for someone who never came back for it. It stays full: each sip takes a quarter less, and heals a random hero 1d4.

relics.name: The Last Orders Bell
relics.desc: Its clapper was tied down for a reason. From round 4 on, every hero gets a bonus action at the start of the round. Drink up.

relics.name: A Keg of the Sea
relics.desc: Seawater, and something still swimming in it. Every fight opens with the enemies soaked through: vulnerable for a round, and slowed for two.

relics.name: The Cellarman's Mallet
relics.desc: Forty years of knocking things in. Heroes' melee hits deal +2, and a melee crit knocks the target dazed.

relics.name: Coach Ticket, Seat 14
relics.desc: Punched so often there's no middle left. Start every fight with a 14 up your sleeve; a hero who rolls a natural 14 gets a bonus action.

relics.name: St Christopher, from a Dashboard
relics.desc: Patron of travellers. It didn't help them. It might help you: heroes get +3 initiative and move 1 tile further.

relics.name: Ruth's Hot Water Bottle
relics.desc: Filled every night at quarter to twelve, for someone who never came home. Heroes start every fight with 5 temporary HP.

relics.name: A 21 Candle, Never Lit
relics.desc: Kept for when she got back. The first time a hero goes down in a fight, every hero heals 1d6+2 and is blessed for 2 turns.

relics.name: The Pilot Light
relics.desc: It has never gone out. Every fight, a random enemy starts burning for 2 turns, and heroes' hits on burning targets deal +2.

relics.name: The Caretaker's Shovel
relics.desc: Worn bright on one edge from feeding the fire. Every kill feeds it: the killer heals 2 and the FILE drops 1.
